recalls.summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2018 GMC Terrain vehicles.  The sensing diagnostic module (SDM) that senses a crash and deploys the necessary air bags may not power down correctly when the vehicle is shut off, causing it to be inoperative when the vehicle is restarted.
